coder_notes: Diagnostic biomarker cohort study (phase NA) with no drug intervention; interventions are sample collections. GBM, IDH wild-type named in inclusion criteria alongside IDH-mutant grade 2/3 gliomas; IDH-wildtype requirement gives cns5. IDH status defines cohort strata (coded enrichment; diagnostic, never candidate-matched). Ki-67 and routine IHC grading not listed as molecular biomarkers. Arms are OTHER-type cohorts with healthy-volunteer controls inside Cohort 1; no arm functions as a treatment control.
